collection.title: Lotus Elan 1989 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lotus Elan 1989 - 1995 requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
